title: FOMC minutes — the October 26-27, 2027 meeting (2:00 p.m. ET, three weeks after the decision)
source: EST: the Board's own stated publication rule applied to a meeting date this session read directly, then checked against every instance this calendar already carries. THE RULE is verbatim from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026"): "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision." THE MEETING is the same page's 2027 panel, "October | 26-27" -- Tuesday and Wednesday, with NO Summary of Economic Projections asterisk. Decision day 2027-10-27 plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-11-17. THE ARITHMETIC IS VALIDATED AGAINST SIX ENTRIES THIS CALENDAR ALREADY HOLDS, 6 of 6 exact: fomc-minutes-2026-10-07 (Sep 15-16 decision + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-11-18 (Oct 27-28 + 21), fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 (Dec 8-9 + 21), fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 (Jun 8-9 + 21), fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 (Jul 27-28 + 21) and fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 (Sep 14-15 + 21) -- the last of which was itself proposed by the fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28 lane on the same rule. THE PARSING TRAP THAT CORRUPTS THIS ARITHMETIC SILENTLY WAS CLEARED FIRST, and is restated because it has now cost three sessions: the 2027 panel's own footnote reads "Note: A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028.", so a year-scoped parse of that panel returns NINE 2027 meetings including a phantom 2027-01-25/26; cutting each panel at its footnote block returns 56 meetings, exactly 8 in each year 2021-2027. The 2:00 p.m. ET release time is the Board's standing convention and is not stated on this page. Filed estimate because the rule is firm but the meeting date is TENTATIVE by the page's own words -- "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting ratifying October 26-27, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 initial research (2026-09-06). It is proposed because it is the downstream document of the very meeting that print collides with: 2027-10-26 is FOMC DAY ONE of the October 26-27 meeting and sits inside the 2027-10-16 to 2027-10-28 communications blackout, so these minutes are the eventual public account of the decision the FHFA release shares a calendar slot with. THREE THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) THE OCTOBER COLLISION IS CONTINGENT, NOT ARITHMETIC, AND THE PROPOSER CORRECTED A SIBLING ON THIS. The 2026-10-27 ledger read the last-Tuesday-times-Tuesday-Wednesday structure as making FOMC collisions structural. Day TWO is genuinely impossible -- 0 of 67 post-policy FHFA releases, confirmed by an independent parse -- but day ONE is month-specific: January and July collide 7 of 7 across 2021-2027 (arithmetic), April and October only 4 of 7. October collides in 2023, 2025, 2026 and 2027 and does not in 2021, 2022 or 2024. So the existence of this meeting on the last Tuesday is a fact about 2027, not a rule. (2) THE MEETING CARRIES NO SEP. The Board's 2027 panel gives October 26-27 without the asterisk that marks a Summary of Economic Projections, so this is one of the year's lower-information meetings -- the same observation the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 lane made when it found that all 17 CB-print collisions in the tape window are with non-SEP meetings, 17 of 17. (3) A CORRIDOR HAZARD, REPORTED AND NOT TOUCHED. This same October 2027 meeting is already proposed TWICE under two different ids by two different sweeps -- proposals/fomc-2027-10-26.from-consumer-confidence-2027-10-26.json (day one) and proposals/fomc-2027-10-27.from-fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.json (day two). One meeting, two candidate canonical files, and event-scan lists both. Whichever lane takes that id should collapse them; this proposal is for the MINUTES, a genuinely separate event, and does not overlap either. Same channel caveat as every macro entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is macro-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
